why: TechRadar's tested golf watch guide partly answers the question. It covers Garmin Approach models with free course maps and full health tracking, but it does not frame its picks by no-subscription or the $300 limit. The niche sites cover the no-subscription part but leave out fitness tracking, or pick yardage-only watches. The rest are listicles or off-target TechRadar and Tom's Guide pages. A focused page could get in, but it would be up against TechRadar.
